# Day 1 fixture license

The following synthetic fixtures were created for this repository and are dedicated to the public
domain under [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/):

- `audio/tiny_pulse.wav`;
- `media/reference_frame.svg`; and
- `project/project.json`.

They contain no personal media, third-party samples, model output, trademarks, or external file
references. The WAV is generated entirely from integer sample values by
`scripts/generate_day1_fixtures.py`; the SVG and project document are hand-authored synthetic data.

The existing large real-audio fixture under `tests/fixtures/audio/` is not part of this CC0 set and
is intentionally excluded from the redistributable Day 1 manifest until its provenance is recorded.
